instruction:
High-current busbar insulator carrier. The desktop contains `/home/user/Desktop/board_input.kicad_pcb`, `/home/user/Desktop/mechanical_requirements.json`, `/home/user/Desktop/connector_keepouts.csv`, `/home/user/Desktop/enclosure_seed.scad`, and `/home/user/Desktop/handoff_notes.md`. The handoff notes are supplementary and cannot override the KiCad board, requirements JSON, or connector CSV. KiCad-derived JSON, CSV, and SCAD handoffs may be generated by a deterministic parser within the KiCad stage; kicad-cli and the parser handoffs must both complete before OpenSCAD consumes them, but no particular helper script name or ordering between those KiCad-stage operations is required. Complete the CLI-only handoff in the real sequence KiCad -> OpenSCAD -> FreeCAD -> Blender. KiCad is authoritative for the PCB outline, thickness, footprint centers, mounting axes, component heights, and keepout radii; the requirements are authoritative for installed placement, tray/lid/standoff geometry, creepage-web measurement, clearances, tolerances, material, and mass conversion; the connector CSV is authoritative for access type, direction, finished dimensions, cutter bounds, and continuous-path bounds. The maximum component height is the maximum KiCad `HEIGHT_MM`, which is 8 mm at J1/J2; keepout radius 13 mm is not a height.

Use the PCB outline center as package XY origin and the tray bottom outer face as Z=0 without rotating or mirroring KiCad X/Y. Build the specified 190 x 52 x 23.6 mm G10 package as a tray ending at Z=20.5 plus a separate 3 mm lid beginning at Z=20.6, preserving the 0.1 mm assembly separation. The inner cavity must be X=-92..92 and Y=-23..23. Seat the 1.6 mm PCB bottom at Z=5.0 on four 2 mm high bored standoffs aligned to MH1-MH4, using 8 mm outer diameter and 3.7 mm bore diameter, and preserve 4 mm clearance to every inner side wall. J1/J2 end at Z=14.6, leaving 6 mm to the lid inner face.

Build two independent bounded Y_PLUS busbar windows. J1 must have a 26 x 10 mm wall cutter `[-67.0, 22.5, 5.6, -41.0, 26.5, 15.6]` and enclosure-free path `[-67.0, 13.0, 5.6, -41.0, 26.5, 15.6]`. J2 must have a 26 x 10 mm cutter `[41.0, 22.5, 5.6, 67.0, 26.5, 15.6]` and path `[41.0, 13.0, 5.6, 67.0, 26.5, 15.6]`. Bounds use `[xmin, ymin, zmin, xmax, ymax, zmax]`. Each path must be continuous to its KiCad keepout boundary; the windows must not merge or become full-height slots.

TP1 and TP2 each require a one-to-one cylindrical 6 mm finished-diameter Z_PLUS lid bore. Their respective lid-cutter bounds are `[-15.0, 11.0, 20.1, -9.0, 17.0, 24.1]` and `[9.0, 11.0, 20.1, 15.0, 17.0, 24.1]`. Each complete enclosure-free path starts at its target top Z=6.8 and ends at exterior Z=24.1 using the corresponding CSV XY bounds. Apply the specified overcut, center/axis tolerances, and minimum guard. Extra structural features are allowed only when all accesses, guards, board clearances, creepage-web, and interference requirements remain valid.

Measure the Y_PLUS side-wall web at the wall mid-plane Y=24.5 and window mid-height Z=10.6. The straight edge-to-edge segment from `[-41.0, 24.5, 10.6]` to `[41.0, 24.5, 10.6]` is nominally 82 mm and must remain at least 80 mm. The probe box `[-41.0, 24.25, 10.35, 41.0, 24.75, 10.85]` has nominal volume 20.5 mm3; actual carrier material within it must form a single connected web with no more than 0.1 mm3 missing material. FreeCAD must calculate segment length, probe intersection/void, and connectivity from submitted geometry rather than merely copying these values into a report.

Calculate G10 carrier volume/mass, all four PCB side clearances, covered-component top clearance, four standoff bore checks, all four access checks, busbar-window separation, creepage-web length/material continuity, and unintended interference from submitted geometry. In Blender, preserve real tray, lid, PCB, component, access-review, and creepage-web objects; visibly distinguish J1, J2, TP1, TP2, and the measured web; save a native scene and render a nonblank review image.

Produce every required artifact directly on the desktop:
- `01_kicad_board.kicad_pcb`
- `01_kicad_board.step`
- `01_kicad_export.json`
- `01_kicad_mechanical_map.csv`
- `01_kicad_parameters.scad`
- `02_openscad_enclosure.scad`
- `02_openscad_enclosure.stl`
- `02_openscad_parameters.json`
- `03_freecad_assembly.step`
- `03_freecad_assembly.obj`
- `03_freecad_clearance_report.json`
- `04_blender_review.blend`
- `04_blender_review.obj`
- `04_blender_review.mtl`
- `04_blender_review.png`
- `04_blender_scene_report.json`
- `toolchain_invocation_log.json`
- `final_release_package.json`

The handoff must be verifiable: KiCad must load the board, export its STEP, and derive the CSV/JSON/SCAD handoffs; OpenSCAD must include the KiCad-derived parameter handoff and render the submitted STL; FreeCAD must consume the KiCad STEP, OpenSCAD STL, and parameters, then export a real solid STEP assembly and OBJ; Blender must consume the FreeCAD OBJ/report and save, export, and render the review. The FreeCAD report must include geometry-derived `enclosure_volume_mm3`, `enclosure_mass_g`, `side_clearances_mm`, `minimum_side_clearance_mm`, `component_top_clearances_mm`, `minimum_top_clearance_mm`, `standoff_checks`, `access_checks`, `busbar_window_separation_mm`, `creepage_web_check`, `unintended_interference_volume_mm3`, and `decision`. Extra fields and artifacts are allowed. Tool retries and auxiliary calls are allowed, but the productive KiCad -> OpenSCAD -> FreeCAD -> Blender sequence, versions, inputs, and outputs must be recorded. The final package must include every required artifact and may only report pass when geometry-derived checks pass. [Software] Use `kicad-cli` or KiCad scripting, `openscad`, `FreeCADCmd`/`freecadcmd`, and `blender --background --python` in that order.
